metrics.label: Revenue growth
metrics.reading: Revenue compounded 8% a year over 5 years, -2% over 3 (slowing); last 12 months 11%.

metrics.label: Profit growth
metrics.reading: Profit compounded 8% a year over 5 years, 10% over 3; last 12 months 147%.

metrics.label: Cash conversion
metrics.reading: Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 245% of net profit (strong).

metrics.label: Debt
metrics.reading: Borrowings ₹92,382 cr, 0.90× equity; up from ₹75,561 cr in FY22.

bull.point: The company successfully beat its fixed cost reduction target, achieving an annualized saving of over £200 million in FY2026.
Management has demonstrated growth ambition by raising the FY27 volume growth target to at least 2 million tons.
Operational execution remains strong with the successful commissioning of the Combi mill and the Ludhiana plant during FY2026.

bear.point: The company missed its FY26 net debt reduction target, with borrowings remaining high at ₹92,382 crore.
Operating margins have significantly compressed from 26% in FY22 to 15% in FY26, reflecting ongoing profitability challenges.
Several key performance targets, including NINL EBITDA and domestic pricing, were missed, while other initiatives have gone quiet or lapsed.
